title: How he came to Blanche Calloway, Claude Hopkins, Benny Carter and Basie
summary: Avery Baker recommended him to Blanche Calloway (1933-36), then Claude Hopkins (1936-39), Benny Carter and Basie.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: How did Blanche know about you?
She had a... There was a guy who used to play with Zack Whyte named Abie Baker.

Yeah. Abie Baker. And he recommended me to her. So I stayed with her for about, oh, I guess, three or four years [1933-36]; three or four years, and then I joined Claude Hopkins, and I worked with Claude for about three or four years [1936-39]. Then I went with Benny Carter for a year or so [1939], a couple of years maybe. Then I was with... Then I went with Count Basie -- a couple of times. You know? Two or three times.
You mean you would leave and come back?
